title: Bus & Rail Transit Guide
subtitle: Nearest bus stands and railway stations matched to your first and last stops.

mdu-junction.name: Madurai Junction Railway Station
mdu-junction.directions: Exit via the East Gate towards West Veli Street for a quick 5-minute auto or 12-minute heritage walk to Meenakshi Amman West Tower.
mdu-junction.platformHint: Prepaid auto booth is outside Platform 1 East Exit.

mdu-periyar-bus.name: Periyar Bus Stand
mdu-periyar-bus.directions: Central city hub right beside Madurai Junction. Frequent town buses loop past West Tower, Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal, and Teppakulam.
mdu-periyar-bus.platformHint: Bay 3–6 serve Teppakulam and Thiruparankundram routes.

mdu-mattuthavani-bus.name: Mattuthavani (MGR) Integrated Bus Terminus
mdu-mattuthavani-bus.directions: Main intercity terminus for Chennai, Trichy, and Rameswaram buses. Catch town bus 77A or a 20-minute auto down Anna Nagar to the temple core.
mdu-mattuthavani-bus.platformHint: Town buses depart from the front outer bay every 8–10 minutes.

kmu-bus-stand.name: Kumbakonam New Bus Stand
kmu-bus-stand.directions: Located 1.2 km east of Mahamaham Tank. Walk or take a 5-minute shared auto directly to Kasi Viswanathar and Sarangapani streets.
kmu-bus-stand.platformHint: Buses to Swamimalai, Darasuram, and Thanjavur leave from Bays 1–4.

kmu-railway-station.name: Kumbakonam Railway Station
kmu-railway-station.directions: Direct rail link from Chennai Egmore, Trichy, and Thanjavur. Station Road meets Mahamaham Tank within 1.1 km.
kmu-railway-station.platformHint: Local auto stand is right outside the main portico.
